The main takeaway from our work is that
the isolation and assay conditions for polyribosome preparations from rat liver should be carefully monitored and controlled.
a polyribosomal amino acid incorporation system can be prepared from rat liver which is active for at least 10 min.

the polyribosomal system is more active in vitro when isolated from cell sap which is not contaminated by mitochondria, and that polyribosomes isolated by the use of 1.67% deoxycholate in the presence of 0.1 M KCl are more active in vitro than those obtained by the use of Triton detergants.
